notes.text: Gursak transliterates גורסק; its vocalization remains uncertain and no identification with another figure is made.
In the linked passage, Gursak son of Dari says in the name of Rav Menashya bar Sheguvli, who said in the name of Rav, that the same quantities apply to an eruv.
